page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.2xlarge is a virtual server in the High Clock Speed family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at 3.3 GHz across 8 dedicated virtual CPUs. The memory subsystem provides 64.0 GB of total RAM, delivering an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU core.

The instance includes an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not provided, requiring instances to utilize external block storage volumes for system and data disks. Hardware acceleration is absent, with no GPUs attached to the configuration.

From an engineering tradeoff perspective, the combination of a 3.3 GHz clock frequency and a high 1:8 compute-to-memory density provides substantial per-core memory capacity without sacrificing processor clock speed. This balance makes the instance appropriate for memory-intensive enterprise software, in-memory caching layers, relational database hosting, and high-throughput computational workloads.
